description: Fictional past tickets. No personal data.

tickets.customer_message: ana 3ayez a3mel return lel jacket, el ma2as kebeer
tickets.resolution: Return opened inside the 14-day window; courier pickup arranged within 3 working days.

tickets.customer_message: الاوردر متأخر 5 ايام ومحدش رد عليا
tickets.resolution: Order was 5 days past the latest expected date; EGP 100 voucher issued per the late-delivery policy and the courier was chased.

tickets.customer_message: I returned my order last week, when will I get my money back?
tickets.resolution: Explained that card refunds take 7 to 14 business days after the warehouse inspection; refund was already approved.

tickets.customer_message: عايزة ابدل المقاس من M ل L
tickets.resolution: Exchange for size L created within 14 days of delivery; size was in stock.

tickets.customer_message: ghayart el 3enwan ba3d ma el order et3amal, mumken a8ayro?
tickets.resolution: Order was still processing, so the address was updated. After shipping this is not possible.

tickets.customer_message: I want to cancel my order, I ordered the wrong colour
tickets.resolution: Order had not shipped, so it was cancelled free of charge and the prepaid amount returned to the original payment method.

tickets.customer_message: طلبت رد فلوس بعد 20 يوم من الاستلام
tickets.resolution: Refund declined by the 14-day rule; case passed to customer care, which reviewed it as an exception request.

tickets.customer_message: el kobon el 3ayez a3mel beh order tany msh sha8al
tickets.resolution: Voucher cannot be used on clearance items; customer advised to choose a regular item.

tickets.customer_message: المندوب كلمني وانا مش في البيت ورجع الاوردر
tickets.resolution: Two delivery attempts had failed, so the order returned to the warehouse; redelivery was scheduled.

tickets.customer_message: Can I pay cash on delivery for a 6000 EGP order?
tickets.resolution: Cash on delivery is limited to EGP 5,000; customer was advised to pay by card, wallet or InstaPay.
